comparison.objective: Hold a clockwork toy, wind its key at least one and a half turns in half-turn increments, then release it to cross a line; candidate finishes HELICOILs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization and repeated rotary winding versus bimanual stabilization of a coaxial mandrel during a controlled hammer blow, followed by fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Required winding followed by autonomous travel over the finish line versus four contact-driven fractures and complete safe containment. Winding torque and finish-line tolerances are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual holding is generic; rotary energy storage and locomotion test a different physical mechanism.
